mappings.name: native-resource-contract
mappings.limitation: Shared-rule source observations, not four member-specific native totals or universal Swagger equivalence. Retain the original per-member correspondence assessment and compare exact diagnostic targets.

nativeContract.resourceIdentity: Native registered/common/custom resource identity, independent of emitted extensions and custom marker options.
nativeContract.enumeration: Added PUT resource validation consumes resolveArmResources; no alternate HTTP enumeration.
nativeContract.selection: Every body-bearing 200 and 201 must be a resource; one identity diagnostic per operation. Canonical failures remain deduplicated.
nativeContract.change: R5423-11: a resource-valued 200 must not hide a non-resource 201. Existing native declaration policy retained for R5423-10.

expensiveGate.question: Validate the final review correction over the unchanged frozen population and identify every meaningful target/code/member/project difference from the published assessment.
expensiveGate.estimatedNativeMinutes: 45-90 plus build, injected controls, attribution and publication
expensiveGate.budget: One stabilized final candidate, no user-imposed ceiling; retain incomplete receipts and failures rather than dropping projects.
expensiveGate.portableControls: 37 applicable controls; six resource-group-path-parameter fixtures are non-applicable because the candidate does not register that unrelated rule.
expensiveGate.invalidatedEvidence: The old native run is historical, not validation of current 200/201 behavior or current core/library closure.
expensiveGate.reusedEvidence: Pinned Swagger baseline, staging observations, source population and historical correspondence remain immutable.
